name: AddressView
description:
An address to read, not edit: the postal block in a recessed well with Copy, and optionally
its map. Put it in a Field for a label ("Address") and a hint ("Change it in …").
signature: ({ value, homeCountry, map, copyable, empty, className }: AddressViewProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: copyable
props.description: A copy button for the one-line address. Default true.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when the address is empty.

props.name: homeCountry
props.description: The country left off the postal block. Default "AU".

props.name: map
props.description: A small map with the pin, when the address has a position.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
